scope: Frozen synthetic split-conformal coverage; marginal and generator-specific, not individual or clinical coverage.

protocol.selection: One uniformly selected cycle per independent calibration patient, with an independent selection RNG. Unique calibration seed per model seed/tier/day: 300000 + model_seed*10000 + tier*100 + day.
protocol.day_band: Conditional on generated ovulation being present. Report empirical frozen coverage overall and by archetype; no individual or clinical guarantee.
